scope: Current production runtime only; historical prototype summaries are separate and are not API response artifacts.

run_retrieval_scope_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM run_retrieval_scope

run_retrieval_attempt_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM run_retrieval_attempt

search_attempt_rows.sql: SELECT * FROM run_retrieval_attempt WHERE channel IN ('tavily','exa') ORDER BY retrieval_attempt_id

metric_attempts_by_channel_outcome.sql: SELECT channel,outcome,count(*) AS n,min(fetched_at) AS first_at,max(fetched_at) AS last_at FROM retrieval_attempt GROUP BY channel,outcome ORDER BY channel,outcome

runs_by_type_status.sql: SELECT command_type,status,outcome,count(*) AS n FROM parent_run GROUP BY command_type,status,outcome ORDER BY command_type,status,outcome

run_budget_totals.sql: SELECT command_type,consumed_budget_json,count(*) AS n FROM parent_run GROUP BY command_type,consumed_budget_json

claims_by_provider.sql: SELECT provider,certification_status,quality_status,count(*) AS n FROM source_claim GROUP BY provider,certification_status,quality_status ORDER BY provider,certification_status,quality_status

search_artifact_references.sql: SELECT * FROM artifact_reference WHERE lower(source_reference) LIKE '%tavily%' OR lower(source_reference) LIKE '%exa.ai%'

search_provider_or_reference_claim_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM source_claim WHERE lower(provider) IN ('tavily','exa') OR lower(source_reference) LIKE '%tavily%' OR lower(source_reference) LIKE '%exa.ai%'

negative_cache_count.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM retrieval_negative_cache

report_attempts.sql: SELECT adapter,outcome,tool_events,count(*) AS n FROM report_attempt GROUP BY adapter,outcome,tool_events

report_snapshot_summary.sql: SELECT status,adapter,count(*) AS n FROM report_snapshot GROUP BY status,adapter

production_table_counts.sql: SELECT 'artifact' AS table_name,count(*) AS n FROM artifact UNION ALL SELECT 'projection_set',count(*) FROM projection_set UNION ALL SELECT 'evidence_bundle',count(*) FROM evidence_bundle UNION ALL SELECT 'source_claim',count(*) FROM source_claim

schema.parent_run:
CREATE TABLE parent_run (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    command_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_business_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    system_as_of TEXT NOT NULL,
    report_cutoff TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    current_step TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT,
    recoverable INTEGER NOT NULL,
    next_action TEXT NOT NULL,
    consumed_budget_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    projection_set_id TEXT,
    error_classification TEXT,
    accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
schema.run_retrieval_scope:
CREATE TABLE run_retrieval_scope (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES parent_run(run_id),
    release_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    metric_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    period TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_url TEXT
)
schema.run_retrieval_attempt:
CREATE TABLE run_retrieval_attempt (
    retrieval_attempt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parent_run(run_id),
    release_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
    channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    classification TEXT,
    latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    remaining_run_budget INTEGER,
    remaining_daily_budget INTEGER,
    budget_charged INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cache_hit INTEGER NOT NULL,
    manual_budget_exemption INTEGER NOT NULL,
    candidate_source TEXT,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(run_id, sequence)
)
schema.retrieval_attempt:
CREATE TABLE retrieval_attempt (
    retrieval_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    metric_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    safe_metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL
)
schema.source_claim:
CREATE TABLE source_claim (
    claim_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    observation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    metric_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    definition_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_start TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_end TEXT NOT NULL,
    dimensions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    value REAL,
    value_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_reference TEXT NOT NULL,
    release_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES release_event(release_event_id),
    release_at TEXT,
    public_available_at TEXT,
    fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    available_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    certification_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    quality_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    supersedes_claim_id TEXT REFERENCES source_claim(claim_id)
)
schema.artifact:
CREATE TABLE artifact (
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (content_hash)
)
schema.artifact_reference:
CREATE TABLE artifact_reference (
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_reference VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (content_hash, source_reference), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_hash) REFERENCES artifact (content_hash)
)
schema.evidence_bundle:
CREATE TABLE evidence_bundle (
    bundle_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    bundle_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    projection_set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
schema.report_attempt:
CREATE TABLE report_attempt (
    attempt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    report_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    adapter TEXT NOT NULL,
    adapter_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool_events INTEGER NOT NULL,
    output_hash TEXT
)
